name: amazon-mcp-server
description: Amazon research & shopping MCP server using browser cookies — search, product details, reviews, cart, orders (hardened fork: no buying, cancelling or returns)
long_description:
# Amazon MCP Server

Search Amazon, research products and reviews, manage the cart and track orders through your own logged-in browser session. No PA-API keys required.

## Quick start

1. Install: `install.sh` (or `uv sync`)
2. Login: `amazon-lyr login --cookies-file cookies.json`
3. Start the MCP server: `amazon-lyr serve`
